raiz.texto: Tessara demands that Phase II be suspended until a binding instrument guarantees minimum rain-equivalent moisture passage during dry seasons, with independent monitoring of the cloud corridor. It invokes the customary principle that no state may cause significant harm beyond its borders and the spirit of the Meridian Declaration. It declares that a third failed harvest would be existential and that all options remain open to protect its food supply.
